title: Para ti
description: Ofertas abiertas que encajan con tu perfil, de mejor a peor, y lo que piden que te falta. Necesita config/profile.toml; ejecuta jobpipe load después de editarlo.

list.label: Región
list.query: Suiza : ch,España : es,Resto de Europa : eu,Otras / sin región : other

list.name: tier
list.label: Tipo de empresa
list.description: FAANG + Microsoft, otras big tech o el resto. Ver src/jobpipe/employers.py.
list.query: FAANG + Microsoft : faang,Big tech : big_tech,Otras empresas : other

list.name: role
list.label: Rol
list.description: Familia de puesto, deducida del título.
list.query: SELECT role AS __value, CASE role WHEN 'product' THEN 'Producto y diseño' WHEN 'eng_management' THEN 'Gestión técnica' WHEN 'ml' THEN 'ML / IA' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Datos' WHEN 'devops' THEN 'DevOps / SRE / Plataforma' WHEN 'security' THEN 'Seguridad' WHEN 'mobile' THEN 'Móvil' WHEN 'qa' THEN 'QA / Test' WHEN 'embedded' THEN 'Embebido / Hardware' WHEN 'fullstack' THEN 'Full-stack' WHEN 'frontend' THEN 'Frontend' WHEN 'backend' THEN 'Backend' WHEN 'engineering' THEN 'Ingeniería (general)' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Otros (no técnicos)' ELSE role END AS __text FROM gold.feed GROUP BY role ORDER BY count(*) DESC
list.definition: SELECT role AS __value, CASE role WHEN 'product' THEN 'Producto y diseño' WHEN 'eng_management' THEN 'Gestión técnica' WHEN 'ml' THEN 'ML / IA' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Datos' WHEN 'devops' THEN 'DevOps / SRE / Plataforma' WHEN 'security' THEN 'Seguridad' WHEN 'mobile' THEN 'Móvil' WHEN 'qa' THEN 'QA / Test' WHEN 'embedded' THEN 'Embebido / Hardware' WHEN 'fullstack' THEN 'Full-stack' WHEN 'frontend' THEN 'Frontend' WHEN 'backend' THEN 'Backend' WHEN 'engineering' THEN 'Ingeniería (general)' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Otros (no técnicos)' ELSE role END AS __text FROM gold.feed GROUP BY role ORDER BY count(*) DESC

list.name: seniority
list.label: Nivel
list.description: Deducido del título. La mayoría de títulos no lo indican.
list.query: SELECT seniority AS __value, CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Prácticas / becario' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / dirección' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Intermedio' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Sin indicar' ELSE seniority END AS __text FROM gold.feed GROUP BY seniority ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['intern', 'head', 'lead', 'senior', 'junior', 'mid', 'unspecified'], seniority)
list.definition: SELECT seniority AS __value, CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Prácticas / becario' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / dirección' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Intermedio' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Sin indicar' ELSE seniority END AS __text FROM gold.feed GROUP BY seniority ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['intern', 'head', 'lead', 'senior', 'junior', 'mid', 'unspecified'], seniority)

panels.title: Ofertas para ti · de mejor a peor encaje
Clic en el puesto para abrir la oferta
panels.description: Las ofertas que no nombran ninguna tecnología conocida no tienen encaje y salen al final. El orden favorece las que nombran más de tus tecnologías.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100 * score) AS "Encaje", title AS "Puesto",
       coalesce(employer, company) AS "Empresa", place AS "Lugar",
       CASE seniority WHEN 'intern' THEN 'Prácticas / becario' WHEN 'head' THEN 'Head / dirección' WHEN 'lead' THEN 'Lead / staff / principal' WHEN 'senior' THEN 'Senior' WHEN 'junior' THEN 'Junior' WHEN 'mid' THEN 'Intermedio' WHEN 'unspecified' THEN 'Sin indicar' ELSE seniority END AS "Nivel",
       array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT t.label FROM unnest(have) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(key, n) JOIN silver.technologies t USING (key) ORDER BY n), ', ') AS "Conoces", array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT t.label FROM unnest(missing) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(key, n) JOIN silver.technologies t USING (key) ORDER BY n), ', ') AS "Te falta",
       to_char(first_seen, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Vista", source AS "Fuente", url
FROM gold.feed
WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND coalesce(score, 0) * 100 >= ${min_match:raw}
  AND first_seen > now() - interval '1 day' * ${new:raw}
ORDER BY rank DESC, cardinality(have) DESC, first_seen DESC
LIMIT 300

panels.title: Lo que más te falta · % de estas ofertas
panels.description: Sobre las ofertas de arriba que nombran al menos una tecnología.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.label AS "Tecnología",
       round(100.0 * count(*) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM gold.feed WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND coalesce(score, 0) * 100 >= ${min_match:raw}
  AND first_seen > now() - interval '1 day' * ${new:raw} AND score IS NOT NULL), 0), 1)
         AS "Ofertas"
FROM gold.feed f
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(f.missing) AS u(key)
JOIN silver.technologies t USING (key)
WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND coalesce(score, 0) * 100 >= ${min_match:raw}
  AND first_seen > now() - interval '1 day' * ${new:raw}
GROUP BY t.label ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 15

panels.title: Lo más pedido en estas ofertas

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.label AS "Tecnología",
       nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.key = ANY(f.have)), 0) AS "Conoces",
       nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.key = ANY(f.missing)), 0) AS "Te falta"
FROM gold.feed f
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(f.have || f.missing) AS u(key)
JOIN silver.technologies t USING (key)
WHERE coalesce(nullif(regions, '{}'), '{other}') && ARRAY[$region]::text[]
  AND company_tier IN ($tier)
  AND ('__all' IN ($role) OR role IN ($role))
  AND ('__all' IN ($seniority) OR seniority IN ($seniority))
  AND coalesce(score, 0) * 100 >= ${min_match:raw}
  AND first_seen > now() - interval '1 day' * ${new:raw}
GROUP BY t.label ORDER BY count(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT 15
